description: This file defines the ForcePasswordResetException class, a custom exception used within the security infrastructure of the Fineract project. It extends the AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException and represents an error related to password reset policies.

classes.name: ForcePasswordResetException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that the password reset days value must be greater than zero when enabling 'Force Password Reset Days' configuration.

methods.name: ForcePasswordResetException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with specific error message keys and user messages.
